Florida.line: The Division of Corporations offers free data downloads for informational purposes, by browser or secure FTP client, public credentials on the page; quarterly corporate filings at doc > quarterly > cor > cordata.zip contain all data on record when generated; dailies under doc > cor.

Illinois.class: public bulk set under statute, person-downloaded; no automated fetch of ilsos.gov by any route, bulk or per-row
Illinois.source: ilsos.gov/data/bus-serv-home.html (read from the search index’s copy; the site’s robots file refused an automated fetch, and it was not forced)
Illinois.line: Public data sets are made available under the Business Data Transparency Act (P.A. 102-0049): Corporations bulk data (Master, Company Name, Agent, Annual Report, Assumed/Old Names, Stock, Other) and the LLC equivalents. The same page prohibits any process, software, mechanism, tool, device or other means of sending automated queries to the website. A person downloads the files the page offers; the build parses what it is handed and never touches ilsos.gov. Per-row File Detail Report reads by the build are automated queries and are therefore prohibited too; step 2B is struck.
Illinois.superseded: the earlier reading “individual lookup only; bulk sold by contract” (the 2017 page) is retired
